2.title: Sales Operations - Senior Analyst (Japan)
2.excerpt: Operational Excellence: Own Japan’s “Rhythm of the Business,” including the forecast process, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and pipeline hygiene, to ensure high predictability.

3.title: Finance Manager, GTM
3.excerpt: They will manage Headcount, T&E expense, and support key deliverables like annual planning, bookings forecast, BvA analysis, monthly/quarterly financial reporting and ad hoc analysis of the business.

4.title: Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, Cloud & Strategic Partnerships
4.excerpt: Working knowledge of Coupa and NetSuite preferred.

5.title: Territory Account Executive
5.excerpt: Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting..

6.title: Staff Product Manager, IT - GTM
6.excerpt: Strong understanding of the B2B sales process, seller pain points, and the technology ecosystem that supports them (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, CPQ).
